rci1_dataset_name.answer: ENIGMA Clinical High Risk for Psychosis (ENIGMA CHR-P) consortium dataset
rci1_dataset_name.reason: The study explicitly states it used the ENIGMA CHR-P consortium dataset from 29 international sites. This dataset name is clearly identified in the abstract and methods sections.
rci1_dataset_name.supporting_text: The ENIGMA CHR-P consortium applied a harmonised analysis to neuroimaging data across 29 international sites... including 1579 CHR-P individuals and 1243 HC

rci2_hc_n.reason: The final sample size for healthy controls (HC) after quality control is explicitly stated in the text and tables.
rci2_hc_n.supporting_text: Following quality control procedures (eFig. 1), the /uniFB01 nal sample consisted of 1 579 CHR-P participants (mean age = 20.63 [SD = 4.60], 47.37% females) and 1243 HC participants (mean age = 22.32 [SD = 4.96], 44.73% females) across 29 sites.

rci3_hc_age.reason: The mean and standard deviation for the age of healthy controls are explicitly provided in Table 1 and the text. The range is not reported.

rci4_hc_sex.reason: Healthy control sex distribution is clearly provided in Table 1 of the main manuscript, showing both counts and percentages for males and females.
rci4_hc_sex.supporting_text: Table 1 shows HC sex: 687 males (55.27%), 556 females (44.73%)

rci5_imaging_modality.reason: The study clearly states that structural MRI data were acquired and processed. Supplementary eTable 2 provides detailed site-specific MRI acquisition parameters including scanner manufacturers (Siemens, GE, Philips, Toshiba) and field strengths (1.5T and 3T).
rci5_imaging_modality.supporting_text: The site-specific MRI acquisition parameters are summarised in eTable 2. All neuroimaging data were processed according to FreeSurfer automated pipelines

rci6_analysis_level.supporting_text: The application of this protocol yielded a total of 153 structural ROIs: 68 cortical variables measured by both Surface Area (SA) and Cortical Thickness (CT) according to the Desikan -Killiany atlas [49], 16 Subcortical Volume (SV) variables and one measure of Intracranial Volume (ICV).

rci7_preprocessing_pipeline.answer: FreeSurfer (versions 5.1, 5.2, 5.3, 6.0.0); Desikan-Killiany atlas; neuroComBat for site effect correction.
rci7_preprocessing_pipeline.reason: The methods section clearly states that data was processed using FreeSurfer and the ENIGMA protocol. eTable 2 in the supplementary material lists the specific FreeSurfer versions used by each site. The Desikan-Killiany atlas was used for parcellation, and neuroComBat was used for harmonization.
rci7_preprocessing_pipeline.supporting_text: All neuroimaging data were processed according to FreeSurfer automated pipelines [41 -44] and the standardised ENIGMA protocol (http://enigma.ini.usc.edu/protocols/imaging-protocols/). ... The application of this protocol yielded a total of 153 structural ROIs: 68 cortical variables measured by both Surface Area (SA) and Cortical Thickness (CT) according to the Desikan -Killiany atlas [49]... Neuroimaging data were adjusted for scanner protocol and site using neuroComBat [50] (a modi/uniFB01 ed version of ComBat [51]), a batch-adjustment method that relies on an empirical Bayes framework to assess the in/uniFB02 uence of covariates of interest.
rci7_preprocessing_pipeline.location: Baldwin2022.pdf.md: Methods > MRI data acquisition and processing

rci9_site_effect_handling.detail: neuroComBat was used to adjust neuroimaging data for scanner protocol and site effects. The model controlled for group (CHR-P/HC), age, and sex.
rci9_site_effect_handling.supporting_text: Neuroimaging data were adjusted for scanner protocol and site using neuroComBat [50] (a modi/uniFB01 ed version of ComBat [51]), a batch-adjustment method that relies on an empirical Bayes framework to assess the in /uniFB02 uence of covariates of interest. The neuroimaging data were adjusted prior to current analyses, as this approach is recommended by the tool developers for optimal use while controlling for group (CHR-P/HC), age and sex.
